title: Minion Rush Installer
subtitle: Original 1.8.1g release for iPhone and iPad

labels.drop: Drop your signed Minion Rush IPA here
labels.releaseHelp: Export an IPA with the Mac installer's Export IPA action. It contains your private game assets; do not publish or redistribute it.
labels.invalidDrop: Drop one IPA archive at a time.
labels.deviceHelp: Install iTunes from Apple, connect by USB, unlock your iPhone or iPad, and trust this computer. Enable Developer Mode. iOS or iPadOS 17 or later is required.
labels.signingHelp: Signing is already included in the IPA. This app does not sign in to Apple or change its signature. The selected device must be registered in the profile. Expired or mismatched profiles require a new Mac export.
labels.signingNeeded: Select an IPA to view its signing details
labels.importNeeded: Choose a signed IPA to continue
labels.profileMismatch: Export a new IPA on the Mac for this device and operating system
labels.installed: Installation verified. Open the game on your device.
labels.quitHelp: Cancel and quit? A started device installation may still finish. The installer never uninstalls the game or removes its data.

labels.releaseHelp: Use your own legally obtained release. Game assets are never downloaded or bundled with this installer.
labels.invalidDrop: Drop one ZIP archive at a time.
labels.invalidTeam: Use exactly 10 uppercase letters or digits.
labels.invalidBundle: Use dot-separated letters and digits, with optional hyphens.
labels.emptyLog: Import or install an app to see its activity here.
labels.deviceHelp: Connect by USB, unlock your device, trust this Mac, and enable Developer Mode. iOS or iPadOS 17 or later is required.
labels.signingHelp: Sign in to Xcode with your Apple Account first. Team IDs are detected from local provisioning profiles when available. Otherwise enter your Team ID manually. Keep the same bundle identifier to preserve game data when updating.
labels.personalTeam: Free Personal Teams allow 3 installed apps per device. Profiles expire after 7 days and require reinstalling.
labels.exportHelp: Build and sign for the selected device, then save an IPA without installing. The same device must be included in its provisioning profile when installing from Windows.
labels.importNeeded: Import a release ZIP to continue
labels.toolchainNeeded: Install and configure Xcode 27 to continue
labels.deviceNeeded: Connect and select a device to continue
labels.signingNeeded: Enter your signing details to continue
labels.quitTitle: Cancel the current operation and quit?
labels.quitHelp: Cancellation before asset commit preserves the previous assets. Cancelling during device installation may leave an installed app; it does not uninstall the game.
